Senses.PreferredTarget: the Four Modes of Illumination and Function
Senses.Explanation: A four-member set recorded from Linji: first illuminate, then function; first function, then illuminate; illumination and function simultaneously; and illumination and function at different times. Linji states that he sometimes uses each mode. The compact gloss says that in the first a person is present, in the second a teaching is present, simultaneous illumination and function drive away the plowman's ox and take the hungry person's food, and different-time illumination and function have question and answer. Later records retain both the fixed label and its member formulas: Shoushan turns a member into a direct question, Fojian Huiqin maps the four members onto staff actions, Wanru Tongwei lists the set among Linji's numbered devices, layman Cheng Zhengkui gives a labeled verse, and Shanduo Zhenzai gives another. The label occurs 31 times in 22 files; its four constituent formulas circulate more widely.
Senses.Note: One named fourfold set. Member-only witnesses are family evidence and do not count toward the exact-label floor. Later questions, comparisons, lists, and gestures deploy the same set rather than naming different things.

Occurrences.Kwic: 示眾我有時先照後用有時先用後照有時照用同時有時照用不同時先照後用有人在先用後照有法在
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Linji Yixuan, in the Old Recorded Sayings of Venerable Masters (古尊宿語錄), states all four member formulas in his address; the label itself is absent, so this is family evidence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 四照用師一日示眾云。我有時先照後用。有時先用後照。有時照用同時。有時照用不同時。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Zhizhao, in the Eye of Humans and Gods (人天眼目), preserves the exact label and attributes the fourfold statement to Linji.

Occurrences.Kwic: 先照後用有人在，先用後照有法在。照用同時，驅耕奪食；照用不同時，有問有答。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Qingxu Xiujing, in the Mirror of the Chan House (禪家龜鑑), gives a compact member-by-member gloss; this stored span lacks the label and is family evidence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 橫拄杖曰。先照後用。竪起曰。先用後照。倒轉曰。照用同時。卓一下曰。照用不同時。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Fojian Huiqin, in the Compendium of the Five Lamps (五燈會元), maps the four member formulas onto four staff actions; the label is absent, so this is family evidence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 三玄、三要、四料揀、四賓主、四照用，已是臨濟老人吐下底殘羹餿飯。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Wanru Tongwei, in the Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Wanru (萬如禪師語錄), lists the Four Modes of Illumination and Function among Linji's numbered devices and calls them leftover food.

Occurrences.Kwic: 照用問答問如何是先照後用。首山云。南嶽嶺頭雲。太行山下賊。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Shoushan Xingnian, in the Eye of Humans and Gods (人天眼目), answers a stock question on one member; the exact fourfold label is absent, so this is family evidence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 頌四照用曰：有時先照後用，舉似諸方傳誦，拋出無孔鐵鎚，莫怪山僧手重。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Layman Cheng Zhengkui, style Duanbo, in the Complete Collection of the Five Lamps, fascicles 34–120 (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)), gives a verse explicitly headed on the Four Modes of Illumination and Function; the governing source heading identifies him as the Grand Minister Cheng Zhengkui, style Duanbo.

Occurrences.Kwic: 四照用。照時劈箭，好醜俱現。纖芥不藏，日面月面。手握金輪，用處無情。三頭六臂，落膽喪魂。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Shanduo Zhenzai, in the Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Shanduo Zhenzai (山鐸真在禪師語錄), gives a new verse under the exact Four Modes label.
